description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractModuleController' that extends another class 'AbstractController'. It includes a protected property for a 'HomePageService' object and provides a method to instantiate and retrieve this service. The class seems to serve as a base for specific module controllers within the OrangeHRM system, encapsulating common functionality related to the homepage service.

classes.name: AbstractModuleController
classes.description: An abstract controller class for modules within OrangeHRM, providing a mechanism to access the HomePageService.

methods.name: getHomePageService
methods.description: Returns an instance of HomePageService, creating it if it does not already exist.
